product_overview: AxonAI is an AI-driven personal productivity and scheduling assistant designed to help knowledge workers prioritize, plan, and protect focused time across fragmented task systems like Jira, monday.com, and calendars. By centralizing tasks and time signals, AxonAI leverages AI to generate actionable plans, calendar-aware schedules, and insightful analytics, enhancing efficiency and mitigating burnout risks.
core_goals: Generate AI-based daily plans from task lists and historical time usage.
Create calendar-aware schedules that respect meetings and availability.
Integrate natively with Jira and monday.com for seamless task synchronization.
Provide analytics and insights including time usage, efficiency scores, and burnout prediction.
Offer intelligent task breakdown and dynamic reallocation to adapt to changes.
Deliver meeting preparation assistance with agendas and pre-reads.
Send notifications via email for plans, schedule changes, and alerts.
Ensure secure authentication and protect user data with session-based auth and encrypted storage.
key_features: Dashboard showing daily plans, productivity insights, and quick actions.
Task management with AI-powered planning and status updates.
AI-generated schedules aware of meetings and user availability.
Dynamic reallocation for mid-day schedule adjustments due to interruptions.
Intelligent task decomposition with estimates and priority settings.
Calendar visualization of scheduled time blocks and events.
Comprehensive analytics for time usage, efficiency evaluation, and burnout risk.
Meeting prep tools generating agendas, summaries, and action prompts.
Settings with theme toggle and integrations management for Jira and monday.com.
Authentication system supporting email/password and provider-based logins.
Floating chatbot for real-time AI assistance within the app.
API endpoints enabling chat, AI planning, and integrations.
Robust OAuth flows and webhook management for third-party integrations.
user_flow_summary: Users log in via secure authentication to access the main app shell with header, sidebar, and mobile tab bar navigation.
From the dashboard, users view their daily AI-generated plan, efficiency scores, and burnout risk indicators.
Users import, view, and complete tasks; initiate AI plan generation from task lists.
Users create AI-driven schedules that consider meetings and availability through a guided form.
If disruptions occur, users can reallocate remaining day tasks dynamically to optimize time.
Large tasks can be broken down intelligently into actionable subtasks with priorities and estimates.
Users access calendar views for visualizing scheduled events and time blocks.
Analytics pages show detailed charts and metrics on time usage, progress, efficiency, and burnout prediction.
Meeting preparation workflows generate agendas, pre-reads, and talking points to assist users.
Users manage integrations with Jira and monday.com including OAuth authentication and task sync status.
Email notifications inform users about new plans, changes, and burnout alerts.
Users provide feedback or get help via dedicated support pages.
validation_criteria: AI plan generation meets timing constraints with 50th percentile latency under 3 seconds.
Scheduling respects meetings and availability without overlaps or conflicts.
OAuth integrations with Jira and monday.com function reliably, with idempotent webhook handling.
Analytics metrics accurately reflect user time usage, efficiency, and burnout predictions.
Meeting prep summaries and agendas are contextually relevant and actionable.
User authentication and session management comply with security standards, protecting credentials.
UI is WCAG AA accessible, responsive, and consistent across devices.
API endpoints process requests correctly with proper error handling and telemetry.
Email notifications are delivered timely and include relevant plan, schedule, or alert information.
System supports at least 10,000 monthly active users without architectural changes.
